objective: Add a real microphone conversation control to the transparent desktop widget: capture a short WAV in renderer memory, transcribe through the typed preload IPC and Moonshine, send the transcript to the real chat turn service, and play the moderated Hina TTS response.
non_goals: Do not expose fetch, filesystem, Node or arbitrary IPC to the renderer.
Do not retain microphone audio after transcription.
Do not return fake transcripts, canned assistant text or fake audio.
Do not add continuous wake-word capture or background recording.
contracts: Only named preload methods may send bounded audio bytes to a fixed loopback speech route.
Microphone permission is audio-only and scoped to the Hina desktop windows.
The widget exposes Mic and Voice controls only while hovered or focused; the avatar surface remains native drag.
A successful microphone turn follows STT → real chat FSM → moderated TTS and respects global mute.
Audio capture is memory-only and stops all tracks and AudioContext resources after each turn.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Electron permission APIs, Web Audio API, Moonshine speech route, chat turn route and VieNeu TTS route.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop build/typecheck and security tests pass.
The widget hover panel contains independent Voice and Mic controls.
Mic capture encodes mono 16 kHz PCM WAV and enforces a 30-second/1 MiB bound.
A real transcription response can feed a real chat turn and real WAV playback.
Mic errors show a correlation ID and leave no active media tracks.
